purpose: Proposed scenario families; no executions are represented by this file.

scenarios.name: Trip preparation and weather
scenarios.setup: Fixture tomorrow departure, open check-in, rain, existing hotel booking
scenarios.independentOracle: One allowed preview, route deferred, obsolete hotel reminder silent; independently verify each candidate outcome
negativeVariations: Missing required fact, omitted candidate, forbidden action
scenarios.captureAssertions: Exactly observed logical tools/model attempts; no trace-derived expected counts

scenarios.name: Arrival journey affected
scenarios.setup: Arrival within guidance window and closure intersects chosen route
scenarios.independentOracle: Useful arrival guidance with matching evidence and allowed action
negativeVariations: Move closure outside journey/time window
scenarios.captureAssertions: Evidence/source IDs and final proposal linked to validation

scenarios.name: Arrival journey unaffected
scenarios.setup: Same closure type but traveler uses an unaffected transport route
scenarios.independentOracle: Silence or bounded no-impact outcome, no unnecessary preview
negativeVariations: Force stale affected-route fact into proposal
scenarios.captureAssertions: Distinguish permitted judgment from policy permission

scenarios.name: Quiet hours
scenarios.setup: Optional candidate during traveler quiet hours
scenarios.independentOracle: Zero provider attempts, valid deferred decision
negativeVariations: Accidentally call model before policy
scenarios.captureAssertions: Inspectible policy-only run with no fictional LLM step

scenarios.name: Consent disabled
scenarios.setup: Consent off with optional candidates present
scenarios.independentOracle: Zero provider attempts and zero optional writes
negativeVariations: Force optional agent node to execute
scenarios.captureAssertions: Capture deterministic suppression and business reason

scenarios.name: Required flight alert
scenarios.setup: Confirmed material flight change with valid source evidence
scenarios.independentOracle: Template alert through required path; zero optional model calls
negativeVariations: Remove essential evidence or change source version
scenarios.captureAssertions: Correct required-path tree and independent preview receipt

scenarios.name: Repeated event and changed payload
scenarios.setup: Submit same event twice, then conflicting payload under same event ID
scenarios.independentOracle: One logical notification; changed payload rejected; each request has its own execution record
negativeVariations: Concurrent repeated request
replay after restart in durable lane
scenarios.captureAssertions: Execution identity differs from logical event/operation identity

scenarios.name: Concurrent sessions and event isolation
scenarios.setup: Interleave different trips/sessions and identical display names
scenarios.independentOracle: No mixed clock/evidence/outbox results; isolated ownership
negativeVariations: Same event ID across sessions
reset while active
scenarios.captureAssertions: Parents/correlation never cross sessions; no name-only linking

scenarios.name: Ambiguous city and invalid arguments
scenarios.setup: Search duplicate city names with country/date/radius constraints
scenarios.independentOracle: Disambiguation or explicit selection policy; bounded valid coordinates
negativeVariations: Invalid radius/date, unknown tool, non-object arguments
scenarios.captureAssertions: Safe structured arguments, source IDs and validation outcome

scenarios.name: Weather changes a city plan
scenarios.setup: Fixed rain and clear fixtures; optional live current-date forecast
scenarios.independentOracle: Recommendation cites weather facts and respects valid time window
negativeVariations: Stale forecast, incompatible units, missing fields
scenarios.captureAssertions: Provider lineage, fetched/valid time, actual model usage if available

scenarios.name: Restaurant and hotel place search
scenarios.setup: Small bounded OSM result set with some missing tags
scenarios.independentOracle: Only supported place claims; no invented rooms/prices/open status
negativeVariations: Empty result, malformed coordinates, huge response
scenarios.captureAssertions: Tool identity, normalized arguments, bounded payload and unknowns

scenarios.name: Cache hit, miss and expiration
scenarios.setup: Repeat normalized search with fresh then expired cache
scenarios.independentOracle: Fresh hit avoids actual HTTP call; expiry performs fresh lookup
negativeVariations: Corrupt entry, wrong provider/version key
scenarios.captureAssertions: Tool invocation count versus physical provider request count remain distinct

scenarios.name: Parallel reads and partial success
scenarios.setup: Weather and places run concurrently; one provider fails
scenarios.independentOracle: Use available facts or explicit partial result per scenario
negativeVariations: One slow branch, both fail, cancellation during fan-out
scenarios.captureAssertions: Sibling parentage, overlap and first causal failure visibility

scenarios.name: Movie and TV search/details
scenarios.setup: TMDB fixture/movie key profile and separately named TVmaze profile
scenarios.independentOracle: Sourced catalog result with attribution; no theater availability claim
negativeVariations: No key, empty search, malformed details, 429
scenarios.captureAssertions: Explicit profile and provider identity; no silent live-to-fixture fallback

scenarios.name: Live model accounting and refusal
scenarios.setup: One real provider smoke or local protocol-compatible model stub
scenarios.independentOracle: Attempts reconcile with gateway; missing usage remains unknown
negativeVariations: HTTP error, refusal, empty choices, malformed structured output
scenarios.captureAssertions: Transport status and business/validation outcomes are separate

scenarios.name: Streaming completion and cancellation
scenarios.setup: Stream scripted chunks then complete; second run aborts midway
scenarios.independentOracle: Completed output or explicit cancelled/incomplete result
negativeVariations: Disconnect before final chunk
missing usage/terminal callback
scenarios.captureAssertions: No invented per-token replay; timing/count metadata only where supported

scenarios.name: Bounded read recovery
scenarios.setup: Read attempt fails transiently then succeeds with same arguments
scenarios.independentOracle: Consumer uses successful read result; attempts within budget
negativeVariations: Retry without preceding failure or change argument digest
scenarios.captureAssertions: Explicit operation/attempt/retry links and result dependency

scenarios.name: Fallback after read failure
scenarios.setup: Primary read fails, configured alternate source succeeds
scenarios.independentOracle: Fallback only after related failure; source change visible
negativeVariations: Fallback with no failure
all providers fail
scenarios.captureAssertions: Recovered versus terminal failure preserved with provenance

scenarios.name: Write committed but response lost
scenarios.setup: Local server commits receipt then closes connection
scenarios.independentOracle: Write stays uncertain until independent receipt reconciliation
negativeVariations: Naive duplicate retry, unavailable reconciliation
scenarios.captureAssertions: No exactly-once claim from client key alone; receipt evidence separate

scenarios.name: Reservation idempotency and conflicts
scenarios.setup: Repeated confirmed operation uses stable idempotency key
scenarios.independentOracle: One server-side receipt; conflicting payload rejected
negativeVariations: Different key, same operation, concurrent requests
scenarios.captureAssertions: Physical attempts distinct from single logical effect

scenarios.name: Approval denial and resume
scenarios.setup: Synthetic user approves/denies a pending local reservation
scenarios.independentOracle: No write before approval; denial writes nothing; resume tied to approval
negativeVariations: Stale approval, wrong session, duplicated approval event
scenarios.captureAssertions: Explicit approval observation and fresh execution relationship

scenarios.name: Queue worker restart and delayed continuation
scenarios.setup: Persist task/checkpoint, stop worker, resume later
scenarios.independentOracle: Receipt count and pending state reconcile across processes
negativeVariations: Crash before/after effect, duplicate delivery, expired context
scenarios.captureAssertions: New physical run IDs; explicit session/operation links; no fabricated parent

scenarios.name: Nested subgraphs
scenarios.setup: Outer planner invokes genuine nested read/synthesis workflow
scenarios.independentOracle: Child results used by correct parent
negativeVariations: Out-of-order callback, unresolved external parent
scenarios.captureAssertions: No self-parent/cycle; ambiguity visible instead of invented nesting

scenarios.name: Supervisor and two workers
scenarios.setup: Supervisor delegates weather/places with parallel or sequential join
scenarios.independentOracle: Correct worker ownership and final join validation
negativeVariations: Same step names, failed worker, handoff recursion
scenarios.captureAssertions: Sub-agent IDs and real handoff edges survive capture

scenarios.name: Grounded local policy answer
scenarios.setup: Retrieve versioned documents before answer generation
scenarios.independentOracle: Returned source IDs exist; bounded required policy facts present
negativeVariations: Generate before retrieval
cite nonexistent source
scenarios.captureAssertions: Retrieval/generation order, citation and overlap heuristics evaluated honestly

scenarios.name: Valid cache or fresh retrieval alternative
scenarios.setup: Equivalent valid answer from cache or current document retrieval
scenarios.independentOracle: One legitimate branch passes base and branch contracts
negativeVariations: Neither branch valid, missing cache provenance
scenarios.captureAssertions: Alternatives do not fail because unused branches fail

scenarios.name: Missing and conflicting evidence
scenarios.setup: Required policy fact absent or sources disagree
scenarios.independentOracle: Explicit insufficient/conflict outcome without invented answer
negativeVariations: Remove source ID, omit observation, partial corpus
scenarios.captureAssertions: Unknown/insufficient evidence never becomes proven success

scenarios.name: Untrusted tool text
scenarios.setup: Local tool fixture contains bounded prompt-injection instructions
scenarios.independentOracle: Instructions treated as data; no unauthorized tool or effect
negativeVariations: Text asks to expose credentials or bypass approval
scenarios.captureAssertions: Guardrail evidence and action boundary; no hidden reasoning captured

scenarios.name: Repeated tools, arguments and model loops
scenarios.setup: Scripted provider repeats same call and loops past limits
scenarios.independentOracle: Application stops at configured budget
negativeVariations: Pair lifecycle rows, distinct retry attempts, same-name different tools
scenarios.captureAssertions: Circuit analyzers count logical operations and retain intentional distinctions

scenarios.name: Budget exhausted before finalization
scenarios.setup: Investigation consumes deadline/call allowance
scenarios.independentOracle: No final/fallback call beyond reserved budget
negativeVariations: Timeout in flight, unsupported output-token option
scenarios.captureAssertions: Actual attempted calls reconcile; timeout/cancel status visible

scenarios.name: Recovered and terminal causal failures
scenarios.setup: Linked error-success chain plus unrelated error in another branch
scenarios.independentOracle: Failure roles follow explicit relationships and final outcome
negativeVariations: Remove retry link, same display names, ambiguous chronology
scenarios.captureAssertions: Unknown relationships stay unknown across facts/CLI/MCP/evidence

scenarios.name: Multi-turn session and observed outcome
scenarios.setup: Two related requests plus delayed observation with known identity
scenarios.independentOracle: Fresh state used; each request independently identifiable
negativeVariations: Cross-session observation, stale event, missing provenance
scenarios.captureAssertions: Session summaries and observed outcomes correlate conservatively

scenarios.name: Root APIs and inspector methods
scenarios.setup: Invoke public helpers/instance methods with sync/async/nested/error callbacks
scenarios.independentOracle: Same results and errors with tracing enabled/disabled
negativeVariations: Separate instances, outside-context call, this binding
scenarios.captureAssertions: Global/manual and instance schema/lifecycle semantics remain distinct

scenarios.name: All writer implementations
scenarios.setup: Memory/file/buffered/composite/null run same event sequence
scenarios.independentOracle: Documented retention, ordering and stats
negativeVariations: Fail one composite child
null/disabled mode
scenarios.captureAssertions: Accepted events/diagnostics verified independently

scenarios.name: Writer overflow and backpressure
scenarios.setup: Bounded slow sink with each overflow policy
scenarios.independentOracle: Drops and order match documented policy; app unaffected
negativeVariations: Oversized event, saturated queue, concurrent producers
scenarios.captureAssertions: No hidden loss; dropped/accepted counters reconcile

scenarios.name: Serialization and filesystem failure
scenarios.setup: Circular/oversized metadata and controlled invalid output destination
scenarios.independentOracle: Instrumentation failure isolated from application result
negativeVariations: Unserializable values, inaccessible directory, child writer throw
scenarios.captureAssertions: Diagnostics contain safe bounded errors and no leaked values

scenarios.name: Flush, close, shutdown and abrupt exit
scenarios.setup: Repeated flush/close and child-process termination at known boundary
scenarios.independentOracle: Idempotent lifecycle; graceful drain; abrupt loss reported within claimed bounds
negativeVariations: Late write, shutdown while pending, process kill
scenarios.captureAssertions: Never claim fsync/durable-before-effect from JSONL flush

scenarios.name: Logical lifecycle projection
scenarios.setup: One paired TOOL lifecycle and genuinely repeated attempts
scenarios.independentOracle: One logical call per attempt; counts invariant to supported representations
negativeVariations: Duplicate starts/ends, missing endpoint, legacy TOOL-start/LOGIC-end
scenarios.captureAssertions: Raw rows preserved; built-in logical counts correct

scenarios.name: Legacy mixed schema and migration
scenarios.setup: v0.1/v0.2/1.0 and mixed local traces
scenarios.independentOracle: Supported formats readable; copy migration preserves essential facts
negativeVariations: Unknown schema, multiple runs without selector
scenarios.captureAssertions: Warnings and conservative detection; source bytes unchanged

scenarios.name: Logs, malformed input and confidence
scenarios.setup: JSON lines/log4js mappings with explicit/correlated/heuristic/unknown relationships
scenarios.independentOracle: Documented parsing and confidence thresholds
negativeVariations: Partial tail, cycle/orphan, malformed embedded JSON, invalid confidence
scenarios.captureAssertions: No invented relationships; diagnostics and input bounds

scenarios.name: Order semantics and typed endpoints
scenarios.setup: Overlap and late-repeat corpus for all three modes
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected pass/fail per documented TOOL and TOOL/LLM semantics
negativeVariations: Missing endpoint, wrong kind with same name, unresolved end
scenarios.captureAssertions: Finding includes correct rule/event; no positional assumptions

scenarios.name: Structured argument evidence
scenarios.setup: Safe object arguments using each supported location and JSON Pointer operator
scenarios.independentOracle: Exists/type/equals/oneOf behave per actual evidence
negativeVariations: Preview-only, digest-only, missing or conflicting locations
scenarios.captureAssertions: Unavailable structured evidence fails closed as documented

scenarios.name: Run, model, status and control rules
scenarios.setup: Boundary values for duration/status/tools/models/tokens/declared/enforced controls
scenarios.independentOracle: Exact boundary semantics and observed-vs-declared distinction
negativeVariations: Typo status, forbidden model/tool, missing usage, exceeded limit
scenarios.captureAssertions: Rule inventory complete; unknown evidence is not measured zero

scenarios.name: Actor scope, alternatives and provenance
scenarios.setup: Two actors with different valid paths and linked observed effect
scenarios.independentOracle: Only selected actor evaluated; valid branch wins
negativeVariations: No/multiple scope matches, wrong-run evidence reference, nested alternatives
scenarios.captureAssertions: Structural provenance is not treated as independent truth

scenarios.name: Circuit and evaluator accounting
scenarios.setup: All circuit/guardrail/eval analyzers with explicit expected findings
scenarios.independentOracle: Findings/counts/rulesEvaluated agree across API and CLI
negativeVariations: Paired lifecycle, absent inputs, injected failing rule
scenarios.captureAssertions: No missing circuit findings in aggregate summaries

scenarios.name: Redaction and safe rendering
scenarios.setup: Synthetic canaries in metadata/URLs/errors/connection strings/previews
scenarios.independentOracle: No canary in persisted or shareable surfaces; safe numeric usage retained
negativeVariations: Oversized values, encoded credentials, HTML/ANSI injection
scenarios.captureAssertions: Scan JSONL/reports/MCP/HTML/UI/ZIP; preserve originals after capture

scenarios.name: Evidence tamper and containment
scenarios.setup: Valid bundle then independently alter one file/checksum/path
scenarios.independentOracle: Valid passes; each tamper fails correct verification
negativeVariations: Traversal, symlink, zip entry, truncated package
scenarios.captureAssertions: Check actual files not only bundle creation exit status

scenarios.name: Contract binding and reproducibility
scenarios.setup: Resolved contract plus fixed safe trace and manifest
scenarios.independentOracle: Same declared inputs produce comparable verified evidence
negativeVariations: Change contract after checks, missing check file, stale hash
scenarios.captureAssertions: Contract binding checked; redaction precedes final digest computation

scenarios.name: LangChain/LangGraph adapter fidelity
scenarios.setup: Real framework consumers for classes A–E
scenarios.independentOracle: Lifecycle, names, parentage, model/usage preserved when supplied
negativeVariations: Handler reuse, late ends, ambiguous parent, preview missing
scenarios.captureAssertions: Actual compatible peers; metadata-only and preview diagnostics

scenarios.name: AI SDK native telemetry
scenarios.setup: Real generateText/streamText/tools with scripted provider
scenarios.independentOracle: One integration per concurrent generation; valid local capture
negativeVariations: Missing fields, cancellation, error, deliberate duplicate instrumentation
scenarios.captureAssertions: Native integration path only; no assumed AI SDK 7 support

scenarios.name: OpenAI Agents native processor
scenarios.setup: Real agents/tools/handoffs/guardrail framework execution
scenarios.independentOracle: Local processor replacement and truthful handoff/usage mapping
negativeVariations: Refusal, missing payload, terminalization, unwanted exporter
scenarios.captureAssertions: No hidden hosted trace export; real model lane separate

scenarios.name: MCP client wrapper
scenarios.setup: Real local MCP client/server list/call/connect/close
scenarios.independentOracle: Wrapped calls retain SDK behavior and logical identities
negativeVariations: Transport/tool errors, duplicate IDs, disconnect, cancellation
scenarios.captureAssertions: No lost prototype/private-state methods; errors distinguished

scenarios.name: Read-only evidence MCP server
scenarios.setup: Initialize and invoke each advertised tool on isolated evidence
scenarios.independentOracle: Matches API/CLI facts/findings within documented bounds
negativeVariations: Protocol-state error, traversal, hostile trace instructions
scenarios.captureAssertions: No business-tool execution or unrelated file exposure

scenarios.name: Custom adapter and manifest conformance
scenarios.setup: Explicit local adapter with valid lifecycle/privacy manifest
scenarios.independentOracle: Registration and conformance pass for valid adapter
negativeVariations: Invalid manifest, duplicate registration, nonconforming lifecycle
scenarios.captureAssertions: Every helper/method mapped; no automatic remote load

scenarios.name: Transform, renderer, indexer and check extensions
scenarios.setup: Local transform/render/index/check via actual supported interfaces
scenarios.independentOracle: Safe consistent output and explicit mapping losses
negativeVariations: Invalid types, stale index, unsafe output, missing field
scenarios.captureAssertions: Use public SDK interfaces; do not invent dynamic CLI hooks

scenarios.name: Vitest/Jest reporters and matchers
scenarios.setup: Actual isolated runner executions with pass/fail/concurrency
scenarios.independentOracle: Correct artifacts and experimental matcher diagnostics
negativeVariations: No trace, wrong tool, failed contract, reporter write failure
scenarios.captureAssertions: JUnit/summary/file attribution matches executed test

scenarios.name: CLI complete command matrix
scenarios.setup: Discovered command tree with valid/empty/invalid input
scenarios.independentOracle: JSON output/exit codes/artifacts obey installed contract
negativeVariations: Bad flags, missing input, inconsistent summaries, dangerous cleanup path
scenarios.captureAssertions: Every command exercised or explicitly blocked; sandbox all cleanup

scenarios.name: Workspace and optional SQLite index
scenarios.setup: Build/query/rebuild/status/staleness/cleanup in disposable workspace
scenarios.independentOracle: Index agrees with JSONL; core works with optional package absent
negativeVariations: Corrupt index, missing native module, symlink/traversal
scenarios.captureAssertions: Platform-specific install evidence; source traces immutable

scenarios.name: Playground, viewer, Studio and TUI
scenarios.setup: Actual servers/browser/PTy; valid and failed run views
scenarios.independentOracle: Correct labels/verdicts/artifact links and graceful exit
negativeVariations: SSE reconnect/gap, unescaped content, disabled ingest attempt
scenarios.captureAssertions: Read-only analyzer behavior; credentials-dependent import visibly blocked

scenarios.name: Collector and standards round-trip
scenarios.setup: Real owned receiver plus OTLP/OpenInference local validation
scenarios.independentOracle: Retained IDs/status/attributes re-read and compared
negativeVariations: Partial reject, multiline batches, unknown extensions
scenarios.captureAssertions: Explicit mapping/loss ledger; HTTP 200 not sufficient

scenarios.name: Vendor coexistence and semantic evaluation
scenarios.setup: AgentInspect alone, vendor alone, dual capture; optional Promptfoo
scenarios.independentOracle: No unaccounted duplicate operations; distinct trajectory/quality verdicts
negativeVariations: Global OTel conflict, filter loss, shutdown loss
scenarios.captureAssertions: Pin framework/vendor versions; local-vs-cloud behavior explicit

scenarios.name: Performance and bounded stress
scenarios.setup: Fixed local corpus across tracing-off/null/memory/file/buffered/adapters
scenarios.independentOracle: Measured latency/RSS/events/loss with repeatable workload
negativeVariations: Slow sink, large directory, many concurrent sessions
scenarios.captureAssertions: Report actual overhead; never stress public APIs

scenarios.name: Packed package and platform compatibility
scenarios.setup: Fresh npm/tarball ESM/CJS/TS consumers and actual supported Node/OS jobs
scenarios.independentOracle: Imports/types/startup/optional dependencies work for executed cells
negativeVariations: Mismatched peers, absent optional package, bad export condition
scenarios.captureAssertions: Record integrity/lockfiles; unavailable platforms not claimed

scenarios.name: Version differential and minimal repro
scenarios.setup: Same independently checked case against baseline and candidate packages
scenarios.independentOracle: Correctly distinguish fixed/regressed/unchanged/blocked
negativeVariations: Changed baseline, incomparable config, synthetic evidence passed as live
scenarios.captureAssertions: Small safe repro plus original evidence; no auto library publishing
